name: Typed common-endpoint residual compiler
scope: Finite formal current expansion; executable semantics supplied by separately certified primitive ports

input.finite_program: Typed syntax with exact occurrence, caller, source-version and clock identity
input.current_pairing: Fixed endpoint X and retained-record contract; sum_r E[C_r:D^r phi(X)], including r=0 until normalization is proved
input.source_section: A filtration-compatible right inverse h of the normalized leading-current map on every emitted admitted type
input.primitive_tables: Exact finite native/current jet identities plus separately certified remainder floors
input.old_ports: Complete finite list of every old typed coefficient or observer port actually hit
input.reserve: Uniform delta>0 for every admitted old and new hit port; actual allocation/width/resource losses included
input.cutoff: Effective coefficient grade G<P, with computed one-energy/native/keep bounds on excluded terms
input.local_finiteness: Separately certified reserve-local finiteness, for example a fixed finite primitive/current-jet and side-occurrence census with finitely branching chosen source realizations; not inferred from Psi alone

loop: Expand the complete simultaneous family through supplied finite jet order
Enumerate every conditional, bank, covariance, time, readout and normalization branch
Cancel only exact complete typed identities at the same endpoint
Choose the leading-current preimage of each admitted residual
Recompute actual grade, source allocations, resource ownership, firsts and costs
Emit all descendants; retain numerical and intrinsic floors separately
Stop dependent generation at any unfilled port; continue independent admitted branches
bank_recurrence: Psi_child>=sum_i Psi_i; equality at a common worst width charge
formal_inverse: F_o(x)=x+R_o(x); x_(m+1)=t-R_o(x_m), only when R_o difference raises the certified reserve by delta
excluded_claims: No unconditional primitive-table completeness for future native programs
No norm remainder is promoted to a source
No infinite original-C2 heat Taylor convergence
No general self-trace or retained-carrier admission
No c(P)=o(P) conclusion from finite generation

trace_reduction.scope: Full uniform local-trace sum, independent occurrence centers, frozen scalar coefficients
trace_reduction.gain: Formal generating-class reduction only; no automatic reserve or positivity gain

effective_grade_stopping: G>=P residuals are analytically bounded without compiling their correction sources. Because offspring can lower G, this is not a rewrite-stable G quotient or automatically a truncation of the full formal inverse.
